feedback.finish: After four days of sailing, the Titanic hit an iceberg.

instruction.text: Listen to the statements about the captain and decide which one is true.

b.sound: The captain of the Titanic knew about the dangerous icebergs, but he ignored the warnings.
The captain of the Titanic turned purple when the ship hit the iceberg.

feedback.finish: The captain wanted to reach America quickly, so he didn’t pay attention to warnings about the icebergs.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps about the Titanic sinking.

hint.label: Evacuate
hint.text: Evacuating means getting people to safety.

atoms.b: When the Titanic started to sink, the crew tried to evacuate the ship by putting people on ((++lifeboats whales)).
((++Women_and_children Parrots)) were allowed onto the lifeboats first, but they also tried to ((++rescue dance_with)) the first class passengers before other classes.
There were only 20 lifeboats on the ship, which wasn’t nearly enough to ((++save feed)) everyone onboard.

instruction.text: What do you think the atmosphere would have been like on the Titanic when it was sinking?
As the Titanic sank, the band played music for the passengers. Select them to hear the song that they played.

feedback.finish: After a long night of rescue attempts, only 705 of the 2,200 passengers were able to be rescued.
